$comment: sherpa-layout-grid — GENERATED by scripts/generate-component-spec.mjs from its .html, .css and .ts. Regenerate it, never edit it. $extensions.sherpa is kept across regen; resync-figma.mjs owns it.
$description: the layout grid a view places its content on.

props.name: data-col-span-12
props.description: on a CHILD: a dragged width, counted, read only at that column count; only the grid (or a host putting a layout back) writes it

props.name: data-col-span-8
props.description: on a CHILD: a dragged width, counted, read only at that column count; only the grid (or a host putting a layout back) writes it

props.name: data-grow
props.description: on a CHILD: the item that takes the remaining height

props.name: data-min-row-span
props.description: on a CHILD: 1–12, the fewest rows a drag may leave it; a child without one is not row-resizable

props.name: data-resizable
props.description: draw a handle in each gutter, to resize the children by dragging or by the keys. TRAP T-a-gutter-moves-a-line

props.name: data-row-count
props.description: set an explicit row count (1–12); a fit grid needs it

props.name: data-row-span-12
props.description: on a CHILD: the same, for its rows. TRAP T-a-dragged-layout-is-kept-per-column-count

props.name: data-row-span-8
props.description: on a CHILD: the same, for its rows. TRAP T-a-dragged-layout-is-kept-per-column-count

props.name: data-rows
props.description: fit — every row one grid row tall, and the LAST row takes the rest | fixed — every row is one grid row tall

divergence.note: 2026-09-23: NO FIGMA COMPONENT, and that is the ruling, not a gap — this is a layout CONCEPT expressed as a util component. `figmaName` is therefore absent, which is what tells resync-figma there is nothing to match; the `layout` VARIABLE collection is still the source for the tracks (columns, gaps, padding, row height, breakpoints). Named `sherpa-layout-grid` rather than `sherpa-grid` so it cannot be read as a data grid. An earlier `sherpa-layout-grid` was removed 2026-08-14 under the "code components must map to a Figma component" rule; a util component is the exception that rule needed. The element does NOT re-declare the tracks — the host wears the projected `.sherpa-grid` class so a re-projection reaches it unchanged, and its children stay in the light DOM so every `.sherpa-grid > [data-col-span]` rule still matches. What it adds is each child's `data-group` for `data-grouped`, which CSS cannot compute. A fit grid needs no JS since 2026-09-24: its row count is authored. A `sherpa-layout-canvas` is planned alongside it, on the same footing.
